description: This file contains a test implementation of the InputConnection interface for the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically a class named TestInputConnection used for testing input behaviors and selection updates within the keyboard's input method framework.

classes.name: TestInputConnection
classes.description: A test implementation of the InputConnection interface for simulating text input and selection behavior in unit tests.

classes.name: CompleteState
classes.description: A subclass of ExtractedText representing the current state of the input, including text, selection, and candidate range.

classes.name: SelectionUpdateData
classes.description: A data class holding information about selection changes, including old and new selection ranges and candidate positions.

methods.name: getTextBeforeCursor
methods.description: Returns the text before the cursor position, up to length n.

methods.name: getTextAfterCursor
methods.description: Returns the text after the cursor position, up to length n.

methods.name: getSelectedText
methods.description: Returns the currently selected text.

methods.name: getCursorCapsMode
methods.description: Returns the capitalization mode at the cursor position based on the requested modes.

methods.name: getExtractedText
methods.description: Returns the current text state as an ExtractedText object.

methods.name: deleteSurroundingText
methods.description: Deletes text surrounding the cursor, before and after, based on specified lengths.

methods.name: setComposingText
methods.description: Sets the composing text at the current cursor position.

methods.name: commitText
methods.description: Commits the specified text at the current cursor position.

methods.name: commitCompletion
methods.description: Placeholder for committing a completion; returns false as not implemented.

methods.name: commitCorrection
methods.description: Commits a correction, storing the new text for verification.

methods.name: setSelection
methods.description: Sets the selection range within the input text.

methods.name: performEditorAction
methods.description: Performs an editor action, storing the last action performed.

methods.name: performContextMenuAction
methods.description: Placeholder for context menu actions; returns false.

methods.name: beginBatchEdit
methods.description: Starts a batch edit session, tracking nested calls.

methods.name: endBatchEdit
methods.description: Ends a batch edit session, applying accumulated changes.

methods.name: sendKeyEvent
methods.description: Simulates sending a key event, handling specific key codes for editing commands and clipboard operations.

methods.name: clearMetaKeyStates
methods.description: Clears meta key states; stub implementation.

methods.name: reportFullscreenMode
methods.description: Reports fullscreen mode; stub implementation.

methods.name: performPrivateCommand
methods.description: Performs a private command; stub implementation.

methods.name: requestCursorUpdates
methods.description: Requests cursor updates; stub implementation.

methods.name: getCurrentTextInInputConnection
methods.description: Returns the current text in the input connection as a string.

methods.name: getCurrentStartPosition
methods.description: Returns the current cursor position.

methods.name: getLastCommitCorrection
methods.description: Returns the last correction text committed.

methods.name: getLastEditorAction
methods.description: Returns the last editor action performed.

methods.name: setRealCapsMode
methods.description: Sets whether to simulate real capitalization mode.

methods.name: setUpdateSelectionDelay
methods.description: Sets delay for selection update notifications to simulate device behavior.

methods.name: executeOnSelectionUpdateEvent
methods.description: Executes pending selection update events based on scheduled timing.
